ns2:section.sectionText: Topic Section R: Memoir This course will address the art and craft of memoir writing, including revelation, narrative density, risk-taking, plot structures and trajectories, honesty, and other considerations as understood through North American indigenous memoir. Something is nearly always destroyed in order to heal, and this is especially so in the ruins and re-imagining of a postcolonial America. This is a writing workshop, and a directed course in memoir writing.
